meta.name: WAPA+
meta.description:
WAPA+ is the only FAST channel offering the best programming from Puerto Rico’s #1-rated TV station to U.S-based Puerto Ricans, showcasing news, variety, and comedy featuring the most popular stars and trusted voices from WAPA TV.

Shows: Risas en Combo, Viva la tarde, Pégate al mediodía, Guerreros, Un buen día
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, Plex
